audience: store managers and staff who run one shop on Abacus POS

useCases.title: Find products that are low on stock at a location
useCases.text: Compare the stock levels per location with the safety stock. Look up the names and codes of the products that need a reorder.

useCases.title: Find a customer by email or mobile and check reward points
useCases.text: Search customers by email or mobile number. Open one record to see its contact details, membership and reward points.

useCases.title: Review the top-selling products for a time range
useCases.text: Rank the products sold in a time range by sales. Look up the catalogue entries of the top products.

useCases.title: Trace an online order and look up a sales invoice
useCases.text: Check the status of an online order by its reference. Open a sales invoice by its number to check the sale.

useCases.title: Create a customer and add reward points
useCases.text: Create the customer with a name and email. Then add reward points with a reference note. Both steps change the store data.
